reviews.title: One of the better ones
reviews.text:
OK so I finally feel like I have enough time in the game to give a complete review on it.
Overall this is a pretty good game whether you’re the pay to win type or casual player.

I don’t think it’s fair for me to call this game A pay to win necessarily, but it does kind of flirt with that line in some cases. It’s more of a pay to advance quickly type of game. But that doesn’t at all mean that you can’t progress in this game without spending any money. There are about four different activities you can do in the game that earn you different currency, which can be used to purchase 5* heroes. Once you get enough of the same five star hero you can fuse it into a 6* and continue moving up in rank from there. 

Now while there are in game purchases that speed up this process tremendously, it’s still achievable by simply playing the game, just gonna take longer. And since it is an idle, your tea

reviews.title: What I was looking for
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing this game for about two months now, and I have to say I’ve been really enjoying it. I was looking for a mobile game that I could play in short bursts multiple times a day and this one really fits the bill. 

Let me start off by saying that some of the other reviews are right, it is a shameless ripoff of Idle Heroes in almost every way, but I don’t care. On the other hand, some of the other reviews are wrong, you don’t need to spend money to get above a five star character, it just takes time. If you want to spend money it’ll obviously be faster like any other mobile game. To date, I’ve spent $30 to get VIP 3 status but at that time I already had one six star character and several five star.

Overall I do enjoy it, it seems like the developers update it frequently which I like. There have been several server outages which the developer made good on by providing free gems

reviews.title: Arena needs fixing.
reviews.text:
This game is a blast to play. I have played others that are similar, but they are too ungiving when it comes to the players needs. The games have to make some REAL MONEY to keep going, & that’s a fact; but to overcharge for all the needed items is ridiculous. This game is definitely more generous with giving out needed equipment rewards. 
There is, however, a big difference within the game as far as giving Dragon Coin (gold) rewards & Dragon Coin (gold) prices charged for what players need. The gold for rewards is eked out a little at a time, whereas the gold charged for what is needed is about 10 times what is given for rewards. That is the main thing that blocks building up the heroes & needs to be greatly adjusted. When that is fixed, I’ll raise my star rating.

reviews.title: Nostalgia for Soul Calibur
reviews.text: I’ve been playing pvp video games all the way back to the Sega Dreamcast and Soul Calibur 2. This is a real throwback to the single player mode of Soul Cal 2, with the tournament style and the npcs and playable characters coming from the same list. It’s still an app game, so there are limitations compared to a computer or console game. As expected, you don’t operate your own character in the fight, but you have a lot of variability that lets you enjoy more strategy and control than I’ve encountered in apps like this. You have five types of heroes (Mage, Priest, Ranger, Warrior, Assassin) from six races (Scourge, Human, Demon, Darknight, Shadow, Light). The character design from race to race is very distinctive, and even from within a race the characters appear unique from one another. Overall, a pretty satisfying game as far as apps go for free-to play (like me) or pay-to-play, wherever

reviews.title: Great Game
reviews.text: My wife was fond of Idle Heroes, but the graphics in that game were too childish and cartoonish for my taste. I prefer the look of this game a great deal more, which is what got me to give it a try in the first place. I would not even mind if the art style was even a little more mature. I’m mentioning that other game because the two have similar play styles. This game is F2P with in-app purchases, but I find a once-a-month diamond subscription gives me a lot of options. It is completely playable without a purchase, but it will take you longer to get certain heroes. Most of the baselines heroes can be advanced to become as powerful as you need with no purchases, it just takes time. As with any of these games, you can accomplish more than you think with patience and planning and a little saving up for events.

reviews.title: Best idle game
reviews.text: Prob the best idle game out there love the heroes the tier progression theres so much to unlock in the game the only two things i would improve is one more trophies i feel like the game gives us alot for just doing random things but people like me who love trying to get all the trophies would want frequent updates on more trophies like wierd ones. Also i feel like u should be able to go back to old missions and replay them or even have a smash option like the tower last thing is a way of getting free vip exp doesnt have to be alot but ive seen vip exp given for free through the trophy system so if theres a way to implement that it would be great you could do something like an easy trophy would give u less vip exp and a harder one that takes a long time to complete should give u a decent amount

reviews.title: Trial of hero’s
reviews.text: I have been playing for about a month , yes this game cost alot of money but what game does not ? I noticed this game helps out on gems then most of the the games out there ,this is my first review on this game I’m in the learning stage ! So give me two weeks and I will come back with a better review. I’m trying so hard just for one 6 star some people say they got gifted a 6 star in two days ,I do not believe that atall? reviews.title: Worth your minimal time investment...
reviews.text:
I started uncertain if I was going to enjoy this game and it has turned into a really pleasant experience. Once you have the routine down, it only takes about 5-10 minutes to run through your daily quests and then you leave your troops to farm on their own. 
There is a significant wall, whether it be defined as a pay wall or a time wall is entirely up to you, but it is there. 5 star hero’s will come but those 6 stars are behind that wall. 
I’ve been playing a couple of months, am about to become VIP 3, and have still not attained my first 6 star hero. But, the experience itself, if you are willing to accept the wall is still worthwhile. 
Give it a look... you might just stick around like I did. ;)

reviews.title: Mature version of idol hero’s
reviews.text:
The game is fun and I don’t have to be on all hours of the day to level up. The support is quick to respond to issues. The biggest problem is getting people to continue to be active. It only takes maybe 30 minutes a day to get through the daily list and then you have the weekly events. You can easily play this and several other games and you don’t have to spend a ton to get ahead. Just be smart and save resources. Don’t get caught up trying to race to upgrade hero’s so fast. 
One suggestion would be more guild events. Or something people can do that want to spend more time in game. Too many younger players get flustered easy and give up and leave the server.

reviews.title: Where I put my time and money
reviews.text:
I have spent the last year playing lots of random iPhone games trying to fill the hole in my heart that a lack of any console of computer affords. I play twice a day and relish the time I get to sit down and check on things. 
The game is a test of temperance in that it pays to wait for events to spend resources, but in my opinion that makes it more fun because when you finally get to shell out during an event the rewards are excellent and then you can usually push to a new tier or two on the added power of spending your hoarded tokens/cards/orbs plus the rewards for using the featured resource during the event.

Anyway, I like it a lot.

reviews.title: Good game. But hard not to spend.
reviews.text: This is the game I’ve been looking for. One where you can’t get wiped out by Chinese cheats(whether they cheat or actually spend 100K on the game is beyond me). The auto gather is great. Everyone progresses, spender or not- and when you do spend- it’s not a HUGE advantage over others unless it’s bookoo money. I’ve spent probably $300 over 2 months and still enjoy every bit of the game. The events are kind of ridiculous, because you would have to spend far greater than $1,000 to complete 2 of the 4 week long events. But rewards are decent even if you don’t complete them. Lots of strategy. Support is also quick to answer with any questions or concerns.

reviews.title: Underhanded Business Tactics
reviews.text:
This developer has a track record of releasing new stronger Light and Shadow heroes with great skills only to turn around once the initial summoning events are over and nerf these skills.

This makes it easier for them to then release normal, almost free heroes with highly incentivized summoning events whose skills will cancel out one or more of the premium heroes.  

I don’t have a problem with paying for premium content but it doesn’t make me happy when, instead of the normal course of power creep making these heroes less powerful over time, this company just goes in when it feels like it and weakens the skills that the people that actually pay to play this game paid for.  Some consider this bait and switch and some might argue that it’s not but when it has become the norm it most certainly is.

reviews.title: Great game!
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing for a couple of weeks now and I really enjoy it. Obtaining new hero's is relatively easy. With a little patience, getting 5 stars heroes is easy. The fact that the game plays for you while the app is closed is awesome. It makes leveling and getting basic mats pretty easy. 

I do have a few suggestions. It would be nice if I can click on another player to see their heroes. I would like to see their gear, gems, etc and just general set up. It would be cool if there was a story mode or some sort of story to it. There are a ton of cool heroes and it would nice to read a little into their background.

reviews.title: I play daily and I have fun
reviews.text: First I will say that I do support the developers and spend, but that’s by my choice b/c i thoroughly enjoy the game.(I just buy the monthly packs nothing crazy) but I’ve noticed the game is set up to challenge you at whatever level your characters are at and there’s a multitude of ways to level up and contests to get free stuff daily. As long as the game progresses so that those that don’t spend can continue to enjoy it that’s what matters most as I’d love to have a bigger community as the game works well and has lots of fun aspects that take time to understand and master. Anyways back to playing :-)

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text: The game has enough features to keep it interesting.  Graphics are well done.  Game play is fair - I’ve managed to stay top 100 for most tournaments/arenas/other rankings as a completely free-to-play player.  In game purchases do offer some advantage, but the prices are quite high for most packages considering what you get, which is my main reason for not buying anything (poor value on purchases).  After playing every day for over two months I would definitely recommend this to the casual gamer; players looking for something they can sink hours into each day might be let down though.

reviews.title: Rip Off
reviews.text: I don’t know if I’ve ever seen a game blatantly rip off another as much as Trials of Heroes has. If you compare it to the game Idle Heroes, Trial of Heroes has copied it almost to a T. I personally have Idle Heroes and can tell you that everything Trials of Heroes is, has been stolen from Idle Heroes. Everything from the summoning system where it even copies the names and ways to obtain scrolls and the hud where everything is laid out almost identically to Idle Heroes. The ability to disassemble heroes and fuse to get better ones in an almost exact fashion as Idle Heroes, and even the daily rewards, vip, and gem system is almost the exact same. This game does not deserve anything better than a one star in my opinion because of how they obviously had to put no work in and just copy another developers hard work and creativity.

reviews.title: Really great
reviews.text: I’ve tried a few of these “gain xp while away” freemium type games and this is the best by far. The devs obviously reward players more for spending money, but I haven’t felt left out as a strictly free player at all. They are still very generous with events and daily rewards which provide multiple ways to summon new characters on a daily basis and to strengthen your team of heroes. The only criticism I have and it’s a small one, is it would be great to have some way to earn VIP points, even slowly, like watching a daily advertisement or something like that.

reviews.title: Sick game!
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing this game for about a year I love it between the gameplay to the more the game opens up the higher you go! I’m at level 128 and unfortunately there’s nothing else to open up other than the story but stuck in a stalemate with character evolutions due to low drop rates primarily on the tree of life.
That would honestly be my only complaint would be to increase the tree of life drop rate because let’s be honest those life orbs cost a lot and are hard work to get just for a small creature and 17 leaves 

Just a thought!

reviews.title: Just another money grab app
reviews.text: This game is designed to milk money if you want to advance at anything other than a snails pace. Of course the developers need to make money, but the prices for in app purchases is extremely high. There is no real gameplay at all, you just set you team up and go into battle, without the ability to control anything. The random number generator is horrible and never gives you any good items. I refuse to purchase anything in game because of the constant obnoxious pop ups to purchase in game specials. They also give you a limit of like 50 hero’s to start, which is laughable. Then each time you increase your limit, it gets even more expensive for the next time. Makes it near impossible to do any merging due to no ability to stock hero’s

reviews.title: Good time waster
reviews.text: Good game to kill a little time. The fact that it auto plays while you’re away means you don’t miss out on too much if you are unable to log in for a while. My only complaint would be that there isn’t much to do in game once you get level locked in the campaign. At this point, you get stuck waiting for your auto battle experience to bump you up another level so that you can progress. It would be nice if there were maybe some kind of bonus applied for being logged in so it would be more lucrative to do something other than idle wait to level up.

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text: This game is very fun, and you don’t have to spend money.  I wouldn’t suggest spending a lot of money at once either, because you will be disappointed.  This isn’t a game you can shell out a ton of money and get 10 star heroes right away.  It takes time if you do spend money, and longer if you don’t, but you can still get everything.  I would put it at a 5 star, but there are times I find myself with everything done, wishing I could play more...especially when I spend money, and there’s nothing for me to do, should be a free game mode or something...

reviews.title: Awesome!!!
reviews.text: Love this kind of game but hate feeling like you have to play all the time this is absolutely perfect I just play whenever and I still get rewards and progress from being off!!! Takes a while to get used to it but once you do I would recommend to anyone debating getting it or not! You don’t feel pressured into paying and it’s def not pay to win it’s just the perfect ignore all of the bad reviews on this they just being stupid this game is the best!!!

reviews.title: Good game!
reviews.text: Fun game.   Wish there was more to do, often I’m stuck waiting for auto-battles to level me up so I can move on to the next missions.  A lot of this game is waiting on auto-battles and waiting for timers to reset, which can be frustrating.  You can pay money to bypass the timers if you’re insane.  My budget for this game is 100% towards getting better heroes and I can’t see that changing anytime soon.  I like the small guilds/teams with obvious and fun common goals.  Stuff to do with people in your friends list, and PVP are also fun.

reviews.title: Nicer idle games out there
reviews.text:
Easy to get started and you can level pretty well without having to pay for everything (pay-to-win) like a lot of games out there which is good because whenever I see it's a pay to win game I delete and leave bad reviews.  Making money is ok, greed is not.  

Only con is that it slows down a bit after you get higher in levels, but still a lot of things to do to keep you interested and growing.  Not a big fan of battle level limits either.

reviews.title: Some problems that need to be fixed
reviews.text:
It costs 600 gems for 200 of the leaf blessings. It costs 100 leaf blessings to convert a 5* hero, but every time I try to convert I get the same few heroes over and over and so end up having to keep the hero I originally started with! The creators need to fix it so there’s more variety available for conversion or at least be honest and admit that there’s a 90% chance you will get a spider queen, hellhound, steelwolf, or beast master. Because that is a LOT of gems to waste.
Also they need to stop capping the progress on the campaigns. At this rate you can progress like four levels every two or three days.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: This game is like idle heroes which is awesome only I enjoy the particular graphics of this one better its more my style of visuals. I love the holiday events so you get more items easier, so please keep them coming. I just feel a little guilty because I have spent 0$ so far, and so far so good, 2 weeks into playing this. I’m excited to finally get my first 6 star hero.  For starting players don’t forget to join a guild it makes getting items a bit easier. - great mathalamu (Matt)

reviews.title: Liking this game a lot
reviews.text: I’ve played other similar games and gotten bored fairly quickly. One thing that personally usually drives me from other games is the need to participate in a guild and the ensuing drama caused by this. Maybe I just got lucky this time with a good group. I don’t know, but so far this hasn’t been an issue. I can reap the benefits of being in a guild drama free. In addition, the daily missions are highly achievable, the game can be played and progressed well without pay to play. Thanks for that.

reviews.title: ⭐️< the 6th star
reviews.text:
Trials of Heroes is the best games I’ve ever played! More significantly, support was responsive [to inadvertently deleted account] on Christmas Eve and Christmas day! Gratitude!

As far as paying for the game goes, it’s a choice each player makes.  “Anything worth having; one must pay the price!”
 
Concerning the label of a rip-off; how can Trials of Heroes be a cheap imitation of Idle Heroes when it’s an improvement? Anything that can be invented; already is. Therefore, thanks for improving the cartoonish and childish graphics.

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text:
This is overall a pretty great game. I have spent a little money on it, and really didn’t get ahead at all. You can play this game for a long time before hitting a wall, and even then, as long as you keep playing you can keep advancing. 

I’m at the point now where I will need to start advancing heroes to 6 stars to get anywhere but I am still enjoying the game. The developer offers just enough events and rewards to keep you steadily moving forward even if you are F2P.

reviews.text:

I been playing the game for less than I month and im so Into it !  Can’t stop playing it  I finally decided I wanted to spend money on it and haven’t been able to log in all day unfortunately.

reviews.title: Great RPG
reviews.text:
Update: Changed from 5* to 3*. There isn't enough content to keep me wanting to play. And with games like this you reach a point where you either spend some money or you quit. The Devs aren't being active in making this as robust as similar games by other developers, so I'm moving on.

Aside from having better graphics than Idle Heroes, they've resolved some key issues and added their own fun twists. All in all I'm very happy to have discovered this game. IdleHeroes has a long standing purchasing issue they refuse to sort out; no such issues with ToH. Cheers to the Devs - great game! 

-Fungus, S115

reviews.title: Fun but Crashes
reviews.text:
I still give it 5 Stars, because after one month of playing, I continue to enjoy this game. There are many things that you can do and the developers keep adding new stuff and challenges.
You do not have to pay to win, but it will take you longer to move up, but you certainly can still remain competitive
The game crashes a lot, which can be annoying, but it is still worth the 5 stars

reviews.title: Really great game for short “bursts” of playing throughout the day!
reviews.text: This game is exactly what I want it to be: I can play it a few times per day for anywhere between 5-30 minutes per session. It scratches that “Gacha” itch, it’s fun to build your team slowly over months, and the “grind” happens while I’m working or doing other things. It’s great! The events are fun and frequent, and I can play this in addition to 1-2 other app games without feeling overwhelmed.

reviews.title: Don’t waste money on gems
reviews.text: The game play occurs in a few stationary screens. You can fast-forward if you’re a VIP. DON’T BUY GEMS! If you think buying 10 toons at one time will get you better quality toons forget it! After multiple tries the highest level was a 4 star. Even after spending the dreaded 100 US dollar, I could not score a 5 star toon. 5 star toons can be generated on rare occasions from the tree. It also allows you to exchange toons of the same star value and class, using leaves as collateral in the exchange. Overall decent graphics, poor toon development, and limited screens make this a poor game. I wanted it to be great, I invested cash to see if it would make it better, but it did not.

reviews.title: It’s an okay game
reviews.text: I’m a little bit tired of the random character loot box garbage I do love that you can earn the gems in game but that does nothing to make the random character generator less of a money grabber I love that while you’re off-line you’re still gaining goodies might armor many things that break character or characters when you get them when you turn back on it does give you the essence of turn based combat but I would like it if I had more control over own team

reviews.title: Good game turned money grab
reviews.text:
guys,

         Been playing for a couple years. Was a great game for about the first 14-18 months, now have been watching the game slowly turn into a shadow of its former glory. I know the changes made are to Appease the “whales” on the servers, the 1% of users who spend 80% of the money you all make. Sadly, this has robbed the game of its appeal and lustre. I am going to uninstall this game soon as a result. I no longer find any satisfaction in playing a game like this. It feels like a scam, and the couple hundred I’ve spent is not enough to move my account through content anymore. I’d like my money back, as I feel cheated, but I know that’s not going to happen. You broke this game, guys.

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text:
The graphics are beautiful, characters are beautifully drawn. I’ve only ever experienced 2 crashes and I feel that was just because of the recent server maintenance and mergers. Like any of these games, you advance a lot quicker if you pay money.  But it’s also fair in that you can get most, if not all, of the same stuff as paying players, it just takes longer of course.

If you like idle rpgs, I HIGHLY recommend.

reviews.title: I LOVE iT

I would say I give this game a ten outta ten,  the developers update a lot and the fact that this game has a lot of fighting and good graphics is why I have five stars. I have only been playing for ten days and I really like this game , there’s so much levels, so much to explore and that stuff, so I give FIVE STAR.                       Keep going you’re doing really good            -Signed-this is the best game ever

reviews.title: Nice game!
reviews.text: It’s a very nice game I enjoy playing it! The only complaint I’ve had is some of the characters are clearly placed in the wrong elements.. for example they will be poison color green with skulls on them but be put in the fire element or nature element but from the looks of them should clearly be in the death element. There are more misplaced characters in other elements and I hope you fix this but overall I love the game and its graphics! I l👀k forward to watching this game grow!😎

reviews.title: Great game, however....
reviews.text: I love the game. Play at least 2x daily.  Had to pay for things I would not otherwise have, and though level 102 (completing daily missions), my characters are still around level 80. I don’t know how to get 6 level characters yet.  Wouldn’t it be nice if characters strength increased as one leveled up? Basically, I’m not sure what having a high level gains a person. Doesn’t affect game play as far as my own experience.

reviews.title: Fun and No Bugs (so far)
reviews.text: Originally started playing this as one of those offers for money in a different game I love but I actually really like this one. It’s actually fun to sit and strategize how to get past certain levels and balance out your heroes. Another awesome thing is that so far, I have had ZERO problems with it technically- everything has been running smoothly since I first started. Which is so hard to find in a phone game!

reviews.title: To say the least
reviews.text:
Your game is one to play. Prob be, that vip thing.!. Idea, don’t follow other gamers. I play and do not like the, pay to play or for the matter fall so far behind the rest. I like to game and that alone costs.
For the better part. I enjoy your game and wish there were more to just keep playing. An adventure, so to speak. This would get you a lot more people, for sure and this was my, to say the least. Love the game.

reviews.title: Fun and doesn’t need tons of your time daily
reviews.text: Just like the title says, the game itself is fun and light and doesn’t require hours daily to just enjoy it.  However, I’m annoyed that there are level limits on how far xx level character can progress in the campaign hall.  I’m currently stuck waiting for experience to build up enough that I can continue on.  This definitely makes the game feel like it’s dragging on.

reviews.title: Game is wonderful
reviews.text: The game so far has been really entertaining for me. I have been able to compete with the crowd of players, gather gems for special buys without the need of spending money. Only issue at hand is the ability to communicate with the guild, typing in a specific guild name in the search doesn’t pull up anything. Also I am in a guild but it has little to no ability to interact with the other people in the guild.

reviews.title: Great but help needed
reviews.text: Okay guys I hope you read this. This game is really fun  and addicting as hell, you devs have set it up to where I can play and spend nothing or I can spend my sons college fund. Either way I can still be competitive and have a blast, the only draw back is that there is no way to tell what heroes are best and which aren’t. If you could at a help tool that would be great. Other than that this game is very very fun.

reviews.title: Frustrated
reviews.text: At first this game was really fun. Had no problems, everything ran like silk, and was always busy. By the third day of playing I was finding myself not being able to do anything after only being on the game for 30 minutes. But that was ok because I was able to talk with other players. But yesterday, I logged in first thing in the morning I could still chat. But I logged in a couple hours later and can’t chat, sent private messages, nothing! I can’t communicate with my guild or anyone! I tried getting help from support, and still nothing! I wanna play your game! But I won’t if this doesn’t get fixed!

reviews.title: Very very very p2w and no pity.
reviews.text: This game on the surface seems fun and addicting but you will very quickly see in about 3 hours or less of playing this game how p2w this game is. The game rewards you but the quests you have to do aren’t scaled correctly for the work being done. Also there’s no pity for their summons so you’re screwed even if you spend a lot for summons. One of the heaviest handed p2w gatchas ever. It’s 2025 and they don’t even have a f2p V.I.P system. Do not spend your money on this game but if you got massive patience and don’t mind getting screwed over 97% of the time then this is perfect.

reviews.title: Great Game!!!
reviews.text: I have been playing this game for quite awhile now. It is very fun and very challenging. I feel this game could be checked over by admins a little bit more when my overall battle attack is over 1M points and I seem to lose to those with 200K Battle Attack points. This seems hacked to me on that part. The rest of the game is fun and amazing!!

reviews.title: Enjoy
reviews.text: I have been playing for just over a month, and I really enjoy the game. Yes there are things that require money if you want to evolve faster! Which I wish the game would offer some of these things for free or when you win some battle. And I wish there was more explanations about some of the things like: skins, ruins, and where you can get shards to summon the higher heroes. But all in all I really love playing the game.

reviews.title: So many money walls
reviews.text:
Everything is based on how much you spend each week the game is fun but all I can do is pop on for 20 mins complete all daily’s and then I am done nothing left to do besides wait 24 hours for the reset. 

I am already vip 4 and it still feels way to slow especially with the hero cap like come on already give us more space 600+ gems to buy five slots is garbage.

It does have potential tho I don’t mind spending a little here and there I just don’t want to have to spend 100 min each week to enjoy more

reviews.title: No support for use by those with visual impairments/those who are blind?
reviews.text:
Hello,
The music and ideas for this game sound really cool. However, this game doesn’t appear to be user-friendly for those of us with visual impairments/blindness. Please make this game accessable by either making it self-voicing, see “A Blind Legend” for more on that, or have it accessable with Apple’s VoiceOver, see “Audio Wizards” an other games like that.
Thanks,
Ashleigh S. Piccinino

reviews.title: My Favorite Mobile Game!
reviews.text: I love this game so much. It is very easy to understand and so much fun. I am more amazed everyday. Plus the developers take very good care of it. It runs great and adds new events regularly. This is not a game where you have to spend a lot of money either. They give everyone so much. Definitely try it.

reviews.title: Was fun, now just disappointing
reviews.text: Was fun for the first couple weeks, then things quickly went down hill. Expect to wait days to level up unless you’re spending a lot of money. Oh and if you have an issue, don’t expect it to get fixed or to even get a response. The “Contact Us” button hasn’t worked for weeks and they don’t respond to messages on Facebook (the only website and means of communication I could find for them). Don’t waste your money, play for free until you get bored. But there’s much better games out there with much more to do.

reviews.title: Feeling Forced!
reviews.text: Love this game!  It really has replaced all my other games however recently I have been feeling that the game has really been pushing me to buy my way to the next level, and I refuse to buy anything for games!  Sorry, just how I am!  Wish there was another way for us to be able to get to VIP status without having to buy our way that would make this game that much better!  If not, I’m sadly going to have to delete this game soon 😔

reviews.title: Not done better
reviews.text:
Definite pay to win. 

 This is just like other idle games but done worse. Progression is almost 0 unless you spend money. If you do be prepared to have RNG against you. After 100s of random drawled Heros i have yet to see a 5 star hero. 

Needed 7 gems to level my character. They appear normally 1 or 2 times a day. I figure I would spend some in game currency to refresh the shop. 100 refreshes later no gems. It’s like they knew what I wanted and just wanted to see me waste my in game currency. 

Save yourself some heart ache and go play any another idle hero game.

Edit: so I started to change my review as they responded to my review. This usually shows me they care about improving. However they replied to all negative comments in the exact same way making me think they probably did not read my particular criticism.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
Progression is slow, the quests that come along that last for 6 days are impossible to do most of the time unless you spend a bunch of money.   Example:  one was epic summoning of heroes and I think the top reward was for 150 epic summons

Even grinding levels and auto battle, you get very few.  In the market they come up rarely to buy.  You of course can buy 10 summons for 2200 gems. 

I am at the point where progression is slow without paying, which is something I won’t do.  Also, to get really good heroes having VIP helps, but that costs money too

Buying gems gets you VIP points, it’s the only way to get VIP 
 So, VIP level 1 costs roughly $10 for the 350 points needed.  Scrolling through the list of benefits, it does not tell you how many are needed for VIP 2, 3, etc.

reviews.title: Just  disappointment
reviews.text: The game has completely lost its point. I’ve been playing for over six years and have reached VIP level 9; I’ve poured so much time and money into this game. Yet, I’ve never once landed a valuable prize in the roulette—not a single time in six years. What’s more, it’s now impossible to claim a good reward during events, no matter how many resources you’ve stockpiled—unless you spend extra money. It’s incredibly demotivating. Bring some life and fairness back to the game! Otherwise, I see no point in continuing

reviews.title: Exceptionally Boring
reviews.text: I’ve played a lot of AFK games, and this is pretty much the most reductive one. They make no attempt at a story, just presuming you’re not here for that. The characters don’t even have their own names, just generic job titles (Summoner, Executioner etc). You’ll hit the cap on campaign pretty quickly and there is literally nothing else to do at that point. It’s obscenely hard to evolve heroes since the drop rate is nil and you need a ton of copies to 6*. Save your time and money, play something else.

reviews.title: Good game

reviews.title: Too Many Bugs
reviews.text:
Great game (Idle Heroes Clone) but there needs to be a better system for fixing bugs.

Elite Trials is glitched and medals are not awarded in the correct amount. This is extremely frustrating since medals are the main sought after reward from this type of arena gameplay. 

Wasted a lot of gems of arena tickets...

The email attachment to the account is broken so when I tried to contact via the in game system, it did not allow me to.

The difference between 1 star and a 5 star game is not only how smooth gameplay can be, but also how efficient bug fixes can be implemented.

 Do yourself a favor and never play it.
